faqs.q: Can I generate with Seedance 2.5 Flash on MaxVideoAI?
faqs.a: The integration is being prepared. Flash is not yet available for generation on MaxVideoAI.
Video clips up to 30 seconds at 480p or 720p, with up to 10 image, 5 video and 5 audio references.

faqs.a: These options are not part of the Flash offering being prepared. Seedance 2.5 and Flash keep their own supported options.

faqs.q: Are the prompts below real Flash results?

section.title: Prompt Lab — prepare a Flash scene
section.intro: These are scene-planning templates, not completed Flash demonstrations. Adapt the character, action and camera before testing the model when it becomes available.
section.tip: Change one visible choice between variants so you can compare the results.

tabs.label: Character
tabs.title: Give the scene a clear subject
tabs.description: Describe the character and the moment you want to see.
tabs.copy: A courier in a red jacket pauses under the awning of a rain-soaked city street at night. She notices a familiar silhouette across the road, turns toward it and smiles. Keep her jacket, face and the wet street lighting consistent.

tabs.label: Action
tabs.title: Make the movement readable
tabs.description: Set an opening, one action and a final composition.
tabs.copy: Begin with a medium view of a dancer waiting beside a sunlit studio window. She takes one step, turns smoothly and settles facing the window. Keep her hands and feet visible during the turn. Finish with a still composition.

tabs.label: Camera
tabs.title: Try one camera variation
tabs.description: Keep the subject and action fixed while changing the framing.
tabs.copy: Keep the same courier, location and action. Version A: a slow lateral tracking shot at eye level. Version B: a gentle push from a medium view to a close-up as she smiles. Avoid extra cuts.

globalPrinciples: Describe the action in the order it happens.
Use a camera movement that can follow the subject.
Repeat only the visual details that must stay stable.
